Citymaker.Recipe.Fairground.Description: Event grounds: stalls along an avenue, food court, rides, a stage facing an open crowd field, toilets, light towers and temporary fencing.
Citymaker.Fairground.Name: Fairground
Citymaker.Fairground.style.Tooltip: What kind of event the site is laid out for. Changes the landmark, the stalls and the food vendors.
Citymaker.Fairground.layout.Tooltip: Avenue: a main avenue with side streets. Loop: a promenade round the arena. Grid: market aisles. Court: food trucks round a dining court.
Citymaker.Fairground.stalls.Tooltip: Stalls on a site of 0.6 ha. A bigger site gets more, in proportion (up to three times as many), so the streets stay lined.
Citymaker.Fairground.stage.Tooltip: A stage at one end facing an open crowd field that features keep clear of.
Citymaker.Fairground.field.Tooltip: Share of the site kept open in front of the stage.
Citymaker.Fairground.stallKind.Tooltip: Market stalls, marquee tents or food trucks along the streets.
Citymaker.Fairground.streetWidth.Tooltip: Open width between the stall fronts on both sides of a street.
Citymaker.Fairground.sideStreets.Tooltip: Streets crossing the main avenue, lined with stalls too.
Citymaker.Fairground.stallPitch.Tooltip: Distance between neighbouring stalls along a street.
Citymaker.Fairground.rides.Tooltip: Carousels, swing rides and other rides on paved pads beside the streets.
Citymaker.Fairground.landmark.Tooltip: One big eye-catcher: a big wheel at a funfair, a Christmas tree at a Christmas market, else a centrepiece.
Citymaker.Fairground.foodCourt.Tooltip: A paved court beside the avenue with table rows, food kiosks and string lights.
Citymaker.Fairground.stageEnd.Tooltip: Far end (from the main entrance), near end, or the side away from it.
Citymaker.Fairground.backstage.Tooltip: A fenced gravel service yard behind or beside the stage with containers and trailers.
Citymaker.Fairground.barrier.Tooltip: A barrier line in front of the stage.
Citymaker.Fairground.foh.Tooltip: Front-of-house tent in the crowd field, facing the stage.
Citymaker.Fairground.toilets.Tooltip: Portable toilet cabins in rows of up to eight beside the paths.
Citymaker.Fairground.lightSpacing.Toolti: Spacing of light towers along the streets (and at the field corners). 0 = none.
Citymaker.Fairground.festoons.Tooltip: Festoon poles between the stalls and round the food court.
Citymaker.Fairground.fence.Tooltip: Fencing round the whole site with gates at the entrances.
Citymaker.Fairground.worn.Tooltip: Paints trampled ground along the streets and over the crowd field (permanent terrain paint).
Citymaker.Fairground.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint with.
Citymaker.Fairground.treeDensity.Tooltip: Trees per hectare, planted as a shade belt along the outline.
Citymaker.Fairground.Issue.NoStage: No room for the stage — planned without one.
Citymaker.Fairground.Issue.SmallField: No room for a crowd field in front of the stage.
Citymaker.Fairground.Issue.NoBackstage: No room for the backstage yard.
Citymaker.Fairground.Issue.NoFoodCourt: No room for the food court.
Citymaker.Fairground.Issue.LoopFallback: The outline is too narrow for a loop — using an avenue.
Citymaker.AddOn.LightTowers.Name: Light towers
Citymaker.AddOn.LightTowers.where.Toolti: Beside the paths, along the edges, or in the open.
Citymaker.AddOn.FestivalCamping.Name: Festival camping
A row of portable toilets by the camp lane.
